example_type: vendor outage politics not tied to a claim or proof

description: Sensitizing start-list derived from stakeholder salience and this study PQ2 enactment constructs (Mitchell et al. 1997). Deductive probes only. Not findings. Do not promote children to theme titles. Lock a meaning-unit practice sentence before any EMERGENT code is named.

example_type: n/a

description: Who actually moved restore order delayed an action or redefined done and what supplied that pull. Sensitizing probe only. Do not promote to a theme title. Lock a meaning-unit practice sentence first. Lev is the enacted combination of P/L/U not a fourth salience attribute.
what_it_is_not: The word leverage in spoken questions; a finding that confirms Mitchell et al.; a fourth salience attribute
example_type: owner halted failover; payroll clock moved finance ahead of email

description: Capacity to force withhold or override in the named incident. Sensitizing probe only. Do not promote to a theme title. Lock a meaning-unit practice sentence first.
what_it_is_not: Spoken question using the word power; a priori theme
example_type: could delay override or stop a recovery action

description: Claim treated as rightful because of role plan contract or regulation or treated as out of line. Sensitizing probe only. Do not promote to a theme title. Lock a meaning-unit practice sentence first.
what_it_is_not: Did you experience a legitimacy problem; a priori theme
example_type: request treated as they have a right to ask vs out of role

description: Time-critical demand that reordered attention. Spoken language is time-critical or time pressure. Sensitizing probe only. Do not promote to a theme title. Lock a meaning-unit practice sentence first.
what_it_is_not: Spoken question using the codebook word urgency unless the participant said it first; a priori theme
example_type: payroll window; customer SLA clock; ranking that changed mid-incident

description: Who was supposed to make the call versus who actually made it and whether needed authority was absent. Sensitizing probe only. Do not promote to a theme title.
what_it_is_not: A priori theme
example_type: unofficial decision maker; authority needed but not held

description: What triggered an escalation and whether it sped slowed or changed done. Nothing escalated is a boundary not a failed interview. Sensitizing probe only. Do not promote to a theme title.
what_it_is_not: Failed interview if no escalation; a priori theme
example_type: ticket raised to owner; no escalation occurred

description: What counted as enough proof that the service was recovered and whether proof was renegotiated mid-incident. Sensitizing probe only. Do not promote to a theme title.
what_it_is_not: NIST ISO BCM scoring; a priori theme
example_type: user ping vs integrity check; different proof requested mid-incident

description: What the manager would point to to defend restoration: log test approval ticket or verbal reconstruction. Path C no artifact is a boundary. Sensitizing probe only. Do not promote to a theme title.
what_it_is_not: NIST ISO BCM audit of the artifact; a priori theme
example_type: redacted ticket; verbal reconstruction of unused matrix
